instance: Container running ROCm 6.2.4 HIP runtime against host ROCm 7.x kernel driver causes hipMemGetInfo() to return hipErrorInvalidValue on all devices; hipGetDeviceProperties() unaffected.
Newer ROCm base image drops gfx906 from supported targets; build or runtime fails silently or with ISA mismatch.
GLM-5.2 (744B MoE) smallest available quant (~217 GB) exceeds 128 GB unified-memory envelope; loader OOMs or refuses to allocate.
Large dense models (70B+) deliver single-digit tok/s decode throughput due to 273 GB/s memory bandwidth ceiling; full weight tensor streamed per forward pass at batch size 1.
Sub-2-bit quantization applied to fit model into 128 GB envelope; model loads but output quality drops below useful threshold.

Single 80GB-class generator (Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B FP8, 74.89 GiB + KV cache at 0.85 utilization/131k context) consumes 108/119 GiB alone; three-role pipeline (generator + 34GB judge + 18GB extractor) does not co-fit.
gpt-oss-120b MXFP4 on stock vLLM v0.20.0 produces content:null and reasoning:null output via non-native FP4 kernel path; tracked upstream as vllm-project/vllm#37030.

GLM-4.5-Air-FP8 checkpoint 104.83 GiB exceeds 119 GiB available; weights at 0.85 utilization leave ~10 GiB at load, ~0 for KV cache; fails at _check_enough_kv_cache_memory with ValueError: No available memory for cache blocks.

Co-resident vLLM processes (Qwen3-80B generator 0.72 utilization + Qwen3-30B extractor 0.20 utilization) crash intermittently with Triton Error [CUDA]: operation not permitted during fused-MoE kernel launch on real long-context inference; 1 crash in 2 attempts; identical request succeeds on fresh reload.
